FAQ

When will QuoteMate be available?

We are currently in private beta with a small group of tradies. Join the waitlist to get early access - we are adding new users every week.

Does it work offline?

You can record voice notes offline. They will process and generate quotes when you are back online.

How accurate is the pricing?

Our database includes current Australian pricing from major suppliers. You can always adjust prices before sending.
